findings.title: Restore the daemon capability guard before creating New sessions
findings.body: MUST-FIX — e07s04: Menu New now defaults to an independent native session, but this submission path sends `open` with `new_project` without checking `snapshot["project_save_terminal"]`. The only remaining UI check of that capability is in the Save dialog. Consequently, attaching this client to a daemon without the advertised capability no longer refuses New: it submits the request to the older routing instead of protecting the requested independent placement. This regresses the explicitly retained compatibility contract documented in README.md:318 and CHANGELOG.md:10, and the same New dialog also exposes independent ACP placement without the guard. Restore the capability check before allowing/submitting the New flow, retain a clear local error, and cover a snapshot lacking the flag so no creation request is dispatched.

findings.title: Label authentication controls using fields the broker actually projects
findings.body: SHOULD-FIX — e07s06: `sync_auth` obtains the visible caption exclusively from `method["name"]`, but the real producer `auth_projection` in src/acp.rs:1284–1290 emits only `method_id` and `kind`; `display_value(null)` returns an empty string. The new controls therefore all render as `Authenticate: `, despite dispatching different captured method IDs. The existing genuine auth fixture already advertises agent-login, client-login and terminal-login, so supported and unsupported methods become indistinguishable in the ordinary action surface; only the diagnostic Details list identifies them. Derive a distinguishable inert caption from the projected method ID/kind, preserving the exact wire ID and bounded/contextual presentation, and test the actual broker-shaped payload rather than only synthetic payloads containing `name`.
